name: MedVR: AI Medical Training Lab
summary:
MedVR is an immersive medical training lab built for Meta Quest, with a conversational AI instructor built in. Practise anatomy, tool handling and procedural steps as often as you need - no consumables, no lab bookings, no travel.

YOUR AI INSTRUCTOR
Ask questions out loud or by text and get answers in real time. Request a topic, ask what a structure is called, or have a step explained again. Learn at your own pace without waiting for a demonstrator.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
- Explore layered human anatomy: peel ba
